about: The text every Agora page shares, kept as one Task Object: the header and its navigation, the endpoints, the deck viewer's labels and the footer. The agent banner's words are their own Task Object, agent-banner.json. scripts/build_site.py renders both into every page that is not frozen. Fields ending in _html hold trusted markup; every other field is plain text.

deck.help_html: Use the arrow keys or swipe to change slides; on a slide wider than the window, the arrow keys scroll it first. Once a slide or a deck button has focus, <kbd>N</kbd> shows the speaker notes and <kbd>O</kbd> the outline.

footer.privacy: No analytics, ads or cookies. The fonts come from this site, and Cloudflare Workers hosts it. The deck viewer remembers its display choices in this browser, and the judges' tour keeps one flag in this tab while it runs.
